question: How can I reset my password?
answer: You can reset your password by clicking 'Forgot Password' on the login page. A reset link will be sent to your registered email address. The link expires in 24 hours.

question: How do I create a new account?
answer: Click the 'Sign Up' button on the homepage, fill in your name, email, and password, then verify your email address through the confirmation link we send you.

question: How do I update my profile information?
answer: Log in to your account, go to Settings > Profile, and update your name, email, phone number, or address. Click 'Save Changes' when done.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. Please note this action is permanent and all your data will be removed within 30 days. You can also email us at support@example.com to request deletion.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, UPI, Net Banking, and PayPal. All transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption.

question: How do I view my billing history?
answer: Log in and navigate to Account > Billing History. You can view, download, and print invoices for all past transactions.

question: Why was I charged twice?
answer: Duplicate charges are usually temporary authorization holds that disappear within 3-5 business days. If the charge persists, please contact our billing team with your order ID and we will resolve it immediately.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Go to My Orders and click 'Track' next to your order. You will see real-time status updates including shipping carrier and estimated delivery date. You also receive tracking updates via email.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel your order within 1 hour of placing it by going to My Orders > Cancel Order. After 1 hour, the order enters processing and may not be cancellable. Contact support for assistance.

question: Can I modify my order after placing it?
answer: Order modifications (address, quantity, etc.) are possible within 30 minutes of placing the order. Go to My Orders, select the order, and click 'Modify'. After this window, please contact support.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We offer a full refund within 30 days of purchase for unused items in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.

question: How do I request a refund?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the order, and click 'Request Refund'. Provide a reason and our team will review it within 24 hours. You will receive a confirmation email once approved.

question: How long does a refund take to process?
answer: Refunds are typically processed within 5-7 business days after approval. Credit card refunds may take an additional 2-3 billing cycles to appear on your statement.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping costs and delivery times vary by location. Standard international delivery takes 7-14 business days.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Domestic shipping is free on orders over ₹500. For orders below ₹500, a flat ₹49 shipping fee applies. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout based on destination and weight.

question: What is the estimated delivery time?
answer: Domestic orders are delivered within 3-5 business days. Express shipping (1-2 days) is available at an additional cost. International orders take 7-14 business days.

question: The website is not loading properly. What should I do?
answer: Try clearing your browser cache and cookies, then reload the page. If the issue persists, try a different browser or disable extensions. You can also contact us at support@example.com with a screenshot of the error.

question: I am unable to log in to my account.
answer: First, ensure you are using the correct email and password. Try resetting your password via 'Forgot Password'. If your account is locked due to multiple failed attempts, wait 30 minutes and try again, or contact support.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click 'Enable'. You can choose between SMS verification or an authenticator app like Google Authenticator.

question: What are your business hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM IST. You can also reach us on weekends via email, and we will respond within 24 hours.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach us via email at support@example.com, call us at +91-1234567890 during business hours, or use this chat for instant assistance.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes! Our mobile app is available on both iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play Store). Search for 'CustomerSupport AI' and download it for free.

question: Where can I find your privacy policy?
answer: Our privacy policy is available at the bottom of every page on our website. You can also access it directly at www.example.com/privacy. We are fully GDPR compliant.
